steps.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
steps.text: In episode 54, Ward and Gideon Malick rebuild HYDRA to bring back its ancient master, the Inhuman Hive.

steps.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
steps.text: In episode 66, Hive takes over HYDRA's faithful, and Talbot's ATCU dismantles the rest. Hive later dies in space.

steps.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
steps.text: In episode 76, ex-HYDRA agents hired by the Watchdogs ambush Director Mace's team after their Quinjet goes down.

steps.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
steps.text: In episode 103, General Hale secretly serves HYDRA and raises her daughter Ruby to be its next leader.

steps.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
steps.text: In episode 108, the deaths of Ruby, Strucker and Hale bring Hale's HYDRA to an end.

steps.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
steps.text: Bucky makes amends for the killings HYDRA forced on him. Zemo kills Nagel, a scientist from HYDRA's super soldier program.

steps.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
steps.text: In episode 128, S.H.I.E.L.D. must keep HYDRA's past intact, as the Chronicoms help Freddy Malick push its plans ahead.

proposed.title: Loki S1
proposed.text: In episode 6, after Sylvie unlocks her memories, B-15 helps Loki and Sylvie fight Renslayer, then proves to TVA troopers that they are variants.

evidence: Side change missing. Loki S1 episode 4: Sylvie unlocks B-15's memories, and 'with B-15's help, Loki and Sylvie defeat Renslayer and the Time-Keepers' guards'. Episode 5: Renslayer interrogates B-15. Episode 6: 'B-15 proves to TVA troopers that they are variants by showing them a Renslayer variant'. The file goes from 'Active' Hunter straight to Loki S2.

steps.title: Loki S1
steps.text: In episode 1, B-15 hunts and arrests Loki variants for the TVA.

steps.title: Loki S1
steps.text: In episode 4, Sylvie enchants B-15 at Roxxcart, and on Lamentis-1 B-15 knocks Sylvie down and brings her in.
cases: ST-085 The Bombing of the Sacred Timeline (Loki S1)

steps.title: Loki S2
steps.text: B-15 works with Mobius and Loki to keep the TVA and its timelines alive.
cases: ST-110 The Failure of the Temporal Loom (Loki S2)

steps.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
steps.text: B-15 arrives at the TVA and takes Paradox into custody.
cases: ST-115 The Time Ripper Crisis (Deadpool & Wolverine)

proposed.title: Thor: Ragnarok
proposed.text: Loki returns to Asgard with the Sakaar gladiators to help save its people, sets off Ragnarok at Thor's request, and makes peace with Thor aboard the Statesman.

evidence: Side change missing. Thor: Ragnarok plot: after Thor incapacitates him, 'Loki and the gladiators arrive to help' on Asgard; Thor 'sends Loki to trigger Ragnarok'; aboard the Statesman Thor 'reconciles with Loki'. The file's Ragnarok record ends with Loki stunned and At large.

steps.title: Thor
steps.text: Loki learns he is a Frost Giant and takes Asgard's throne. He then falls from the Bifrost into the void.
cases: ST-010 The Breaking of the Bifrost (Thor)

steps.title: The Avengers
steps.text: Loki steals the Tesseract and leads a Chitauri invasion of New York, until the Avengers capture him.
cases: ST-015 The Fall of Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S. (The Avengers)
ST-014 The Battle of New York (The Avengers)

steps.title: Thor: The Dark World
steps.text: Loki fights beside Thor against the Dark Elves, fakes his death, and takes Odin's throne in disguise.

steps.title: Thor: Ragnarok
steps.text: Exposed by Thor, Loki lands on Sakaar and wins the Grandmaster's favor. He agrees to help Thor escape, then betrays him and is left stunned by an obedience disk.
cases: ST-058 The Sakaar Revolution (Thor: Ragnarok)

steps.title: Avengers: Infinity War
steps.text: Thanos kills Loki aboard the Asgardian refugee ship.
cases: ST-066 The Attack on the Statesman (Avengers: Infinity War)

steps.title: Avengers: Endgame
steps.text: In 2012, the captured Loki grabs the Tesseract during the Avengers' time heist and escapes.

steps.title: Loki S1
steps.text: The TVA catches this escaped Loki, who slowly becomes its ally in the hunt for a dangerous variant.
cases: ST-085 The Bombing of the Sacred Timeline (Loki S1)

steps.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
steps.text: With Mobius, Loki travels back in time to watch Victor Timely lecture, and warns that the man is terrifying.

steps.title: Loki S2
steps.text: Loki takes the throne at the end of time to hold the timelines together.
cases: ST-110 The Failure of the Temporal Loom (Loki S2)

proposed.title: Hawkeye
proposed.text: In episode 6, Maya kills Kazi for siding with Fisk, then confronts Fisk herself, and a gunshot rings out.
cases: ST-089 The Battle at Rockefeller Center (Hawkeye)

evidence: Side change missing. Hawkeye episode 5: Clint tells Maya an informant for her boss wanted her father dead and she suspects Kazi. Episode 6: 'After Maya kills Kazi ... Fisk escapes but is confronted by Maya as a gunshot is heard.' The file jumps from hunting Ronin (ep 4) to Echo.

steps.title: Hawkeye
steps.text: In episode 4, Maya Lopez leads the Tracksuit Mafia in hunting the Ronin who killed her father, and the hunt leads her to Clint Barton.

steps.title: Echo
steps.text: Back in Oklahoma, Maya defies Fisk, reconnects with her family, and breaks his hold on her.
cases: ST-114 The Attack on the Tamaha Powwow (Echo)
